name: s81ctrl_rg2_s3k8
hold_budget_reason: CDC leaf: two asynchronous roots (clk stream / ckh HBM) through ot_s81ph_afifo_g; every PHY-face pin is a flop at the face (k_rdy registered since S81-SAFE-FIX 10-19)

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every pin at its face in its own clock domain (S81-SAFE-FIX 10-19: rq pin register, rd/rk/wd/status output flops on clk; PHY k_rdy/kr_*/k_wr_done pin flops and k_* output flops on ckh -- k_rdy was the last exception and is now a face flop with kept per-group copies). The flow pin-register hook clocks one domain only; on the ckh PHY face it would put clk flops on hclk pins and add a cycle inside the PHY valid/ready loop.

structural_change: S81-CTRL3 10-19: regional core_clk roots: clock_split_km K=8 (2-D k-means of the clk port sinks, one BUFx24 local root per cluster, balanced top tree), cts_sink clustering dropped. s3 gate2 measured core_clk boundary spread TT 120.8 / FF 109.8 ps on one tree over the 531x324 tile (only the largest root ckh 75.1/66.0 was judged). Same RTL, port, clocks, cycles. Prior: LEAD2-S81/LINK-CTRL 10-19 SAFE successor of s81ctrl_rg2_np (route NEEDS_HUMAN on generated-clock export, fixed b91a2773d; its four stock 16x546 masters had 825 contacts per 81 um W/E face = 10.19/um > 6). Four wide-pitch dual-clock 16x340 masters (same compiler, pin pitch 0.192 um = 5.12/um, 114.48x100.71) replace them; one macro column per PC under that PC's W/E pin half (PC0 x86.4, PC1 x345.6; response FIFO bottom row, request FIFO top row), outline 531.25x324 (PHY PC pitch width). RTL/schedule identical (same Gray CDC FIFO, same read/write edges); inhold/outhold off as np.

job.purpose: S81 CTRL rg2 SAFE: four wide-pitch (<=6 pins/um) dualclock 16x340 SRAM FIFOs, per-PC macro columns

slot_change_request.reason: Wide-pitch SAFE masters (100.71 um tall, two rows) need 324 um height; PHY PC pitch width 531.25 unchanged. Die floorplan refit owed before bind.

fill_reason.pin_bound: PHY-face slot: N 1246 pins over 522/531 um (98%) and S 1321 pins over 522/531 um (98%) (gate1 measured); width = PHY PC pitch 531.25, height = two 100.71 um wide-pitch SRAM rows; total fill 28% (macros 46117 + std 1197 um2)
